text:
kevin: Heads-up: after the egress hardening push in apac we started seeing warmup decrypt failures in eu nodes that route through apac keystore proxy (weird pathing).
anya: Wait, eu nodes talk to apac proxy? how often do we hit cross-region keystore?
kevin: Sparse, usually failover. Logs show `decrypt error: AccessDenied` and `connect timeout` to proxy 10.200.5.12:443 originating from eu-init.
sre-bot: Alert created: gpu.warmup.cross_region_fallback spike (INC-4510)
ops: Firewall change at 03:42UTC tightened outbound to privnet ranges; looks like route table preferred apac proxy due to a previous affinity failover and now packets are dropped.
anya: Risk: KMS rotation for shard-X is tomorrow. If these nodes can't reach a keystore endpoint during rotation we could get permanent bootstrap failures.
kevin: Immediate mitigation: add a short-lived allow rule for eu-init subnet -> apac-keystore-proxy CIDR on tcp/443 limited to 30m. Also add a targeted route fallback to prefer local eu-keystore cluster.
ops: Adding rule now: `fw add allow src:10.50.0.0/22 dst:10.200.5.0/24 tcp/443 expiry:30m reason:"warmup cross-region keystore"`
audit-bot: Audit policy: any temporary firewall exception must include justification and list of owners. Will append to incident.
kevin: Also pushing a tiny proxy tweak to add `audit.origin_proxy` and `audit.proxy_az` fields so we can filter these cross-region hits easily while the exception is live.
anya: Cost question: cross-region TLS egress is non-trivial. billing, what's ballpark for 30m with ~200 warmup nodes?
billing: Estimate ~200 nodes * 1MB boot => 200MB total -> cross-region egress ~200MB = negligible (<$1). Approve emergency window. If it lasts hours costs scale linearly.
sre-bot: Canary route change applied; 5 nodes re-provisioned successfully in eu. Decrypt errors dropped to 0 in the 10m window.
kevin: Plan post-mitigation: 1) keep exception for 30m and monitor fallback_count metric, 2) update route table to prefer eu-keystore endpoints and remove cross-region dependency, 3) delay shard-X rotation until we confirm no more legacy hits.
anya: Security wants audit enrichment logged to the SIEM and an ops one-pager documenting why rotation delayed. Also require explicit owner sign-off before we re-run rotation.
kevin: Owners: @anya (keys), @kevin (network), @ops (firewall). I'll open PRs: proxy audit fields + route tweak + firewall doc. PR link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/2001
ops: Exception will auto-expire at 04:30UTC. Monitoring for 60m.
audit-bot: Reminder: include incident id INC-4510 in all PRs for traceability.
kevin: Good catch team. We'll follow up in the postmortem and tighten routing to ensure keystore traffic stays regional to avoid future cross-AZ/region cost and complexity. :thumbsup:
